versions.content: Service Name Dem_DcmReadDataOfPID30 Syntax Std_ReturnType Dem_DcmReadDataOfPID30 ( uint8 * PID30value ) Service ID [hex] 0x65 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) PID30value Buffer containing the contents of PID $30 computed by the Dem. The buffer is provided by the Dcm with the appropriate size, i.e. during configuration, the Dcm identifies the required size from the largest PID in order to configure a PIDBuffer. Return value Std_ReturnType Always E_OK is returned, as E_NOT_OK will never appear. Description Service to report the value of PID $30 computed by the Dem. API is needed in OBD-relevant ECUs only. API Availability: This API will be available only if ({ecuc(Dem/DemGeneral.DemOBDSupport)} != DEM_OBD_NO_OBD_SUPPORT) Available via Dem_Dcm.h
